description: This file defines API endpoints related to payment processing in a FastAPI application, including creating payment sessions, confirming payments, and handling Stripe webhooks.

methods.name: create_payment_session_endpoint
methods.description: Creates a payment session and returns a mock session ID in TEST_MODE.

methods.name: confirm_payment_endpoint
methods.description: Confirms a payment, primarily used in TEST_MODE or simplified confirmation.

methods.name: stripe_webhook
methods.description: Handles Stripe webhook callbacks to confirm payments when not in TEST_MODE.
